goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, compose a private memo, and access the application settings menu.

findings.instruction: Click the settings icon (gear symbol) located in the left-hand sidebar to open the settings menu.
findings.title: Clicking the settings icon opens a filter menu instead of the settings menu
findings.description: The test goal requires that clicking the settings icon (gear symbol) opens the settings menu or configuration options. However, the application instead displayed a filter dropdown with 'Shown time' and 'Order' options. This indicates the gear icon is incorrectly mapped to a filtering function rather than the settings menu, breaking the expected user flow.
findings.evidence: In the BEFORE screenshot, the main dashboard is visible with the gear icon in the sidebar. In the AFTER screenshot, after clicking the gear icon, a dropdown menu appears with 'Shown time' and 'Order' options, which are clearly filter controls, not settings. The URL did not change, and no settings page or configuration options are visible.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the main dashboard after logging in.
Locate the gear icon in the left-hand sidebar.
Observe that a filter menu ('Shown time', 'Order') appears instead of a settings menu.
